\caption{\textbf{SNV-only phasing of HG002 nanopore R10.4.1 data by six configurations.} Scored against the v5.0q VCF (chr1--22, no benchmark BED applied). Values at 10--20$\times$ are means (s.d.) over ten down-sampling replicates; 30--60$\times$, one replicate. Phased SNVs are given as a percentage of the 2,398,880 heterozygous SNVs of the benchmark. Precision, phased SNV calls that match a benchmark heterozygous SNV as a percentage of all phased heterozygous SNV calls on chr1--22 (\toolname and \whatshap only); F1, harmonic mean of precision and phased SNVs. Rate ratio, switch error rate divided by that of \toolname in the same down-sampling replicate. Margin and Ralphi were run at 10--20$\times$ only; GCphase was not included (Methods). Ralphi's phase blocks sum to 4.3--5.8~Gb, more than the length of the autosomes, so its block N50 is not comparable with that of the other tools.}\label{tab:snvall}\\
